<module id="float_multi">
	<description>A 32-bit floating point multiplier that implements IEEE-754 standard single precision arithmetic.</description>
	<ports>
		<input id="clk">A clock signal.</input>
		<input id="rst">A reset signal (active high).</input>
		<input id="a" width_description="[31:0]">The first operand in IEEE 754 format.</input>
		<input id="b" width_description="[31:0]">The second operand in IEEE 754 format.</input>
		<output id="z" width_description="[31:0]">The output in IEEE 754 format.</output>
	endports
	
	<implementation>
		<step>Initialize counter = 0.</step>
		<step>If counter == 0 then
			a_mantissa = {1'b1,a[22:0]}
			b_mantissa = {1'b1,b[22:0]}
			a_exponent = a[30:23]
			b_exponent = b[30:23]
			a_sign = a[31]
			b_sign = b[31]
			counter = counter + 1
		end else
			product = a_mantissa * b_mantissa;
			guard_bit = product[22];
			round_bit = product[21];
			sticky = |product[20:0]; // OR reduction operator
			z_mantissa = product[49:26] + (guard_bit & (round_bit | sticky));
			if(z_mantissa[23]) begin
				z_exponent = a_exponent + b_exponent - 127 + 1;
				z_mantissa = z_mantissa >> 1;
			end else begin
				z_exponent = a_exponent + b_exponent - 127;
			end
			if((a_exponent == 255 && a_mantissa != 0) || (b_exponent == 255 && b_mantissa != 0)) begin // one of them is NaN
				z_exponent = 255;
				z_mantissa = 0;
				z_sign = a_sign ^ b_sign;
			end else if(a_exponent == 255 || b_exponent == 255) begin // inf
				z_exponent = 255;
				z_mantissa = 0;
				z_sign = a_sign ^ b_sign;
			end else if(z_exponent >= 255) begin //overflow
				z_exponent = 255;
				z_mantissa = 0;
				z_sign = a_sign ^ b_sign;
			end else if(z_exponent <= 0) begin //underflow
				z_exponent = 0;
				z_mantissa = 0;
				z_sign = a_sign ^ b_sign;
			end else begin
				z_sign = a_sign ^ b_sign;
			end
			counter = counter + 1;
		end
		<step>Generate output z = {z_sign,z_exponent,z_mantissa}.</step>
	endimplementation
</module>
